findings.body: The supplied commit evidence explicitly reports no `Functional check:` paragraph. Record an actual exercise and observed results for all three covered outcomes: a same-thread reply, proactive delivery after restart, and an unauthorized approval followed by a permitted decision. Existing test declarations do not supply the required execution report.

findings.body: A clean `npm ci --omit=dev` still runs `prepare`, but Husky is a devDependency and therefore its executable is absent. This unconditional command aborts installation with `husky: not found`; the reported close run includes devDependencies and cannot detect it. Use a portable prepare wrapper that skips loading Husky for production installs. [Husky documents this failure](https://typicode.github.io/husky/how-to.html#ci-server-and-docker).
findings.title: Keep production-only installs independent of Husky
